kind: Interactive design prototype checks through authenticated Codeman preview; no live model, microphone or agent assertions
checks: Assistant collapses to zero and reopens without moving the canvas
Typing shortcut letters in the composer does not invoke canvas commands
Single/multi-selection adds actual object references to the composer
Hold Q and circle objects adds the enclosed object IDs on release
Escape cancels lasso without changing context
Nonmodal cheatsheet, provider/model controls and example background task snapshot work
Example background task can be inspected and cancelled
Voice/dictation preview is distinct and does not claim microphone capture
Help filters commands, summons with visible-view focus, and restores composer focus without a modal
Disabling letter shortcuts preserves arrows, Space selection and valid selectable-object semantics
Early Q release and blur cancel partial lasso without committing context
Pan and Fit work; object creation is visibly disconnected rather than a dead active control
Canvas group heading selects its full bounds and attaches one named reference with eight explicit descendants
Attaching a parent replaces overlapping child references; adding a covered child does not duplicate context
Mixed parent/child multi-selection normalizes to one group context reference
Outline selection attaches the same group; example task resolves the group and each child exactly once
Keyboard navigation and object opening recognize the group instead of showing an unrelated element
